QUÉ SE CONSTRUYE
Tres manejadores nuevos en game/floors/objectives/:
- objective.gd: la base.
- televisions_objective.gd: envuelve game/app/televisions.gd (`level.tvs`).
- code_objective.gd: envuelve game/app/code_lock.gd (`level.code`).

Los manejadores son adaptadores finos (RefCounted) y no mueven lógica. televisions.gd, code_lock.gd y floor_save.gd no se tocan, y tampoco los RPC, sus nombres ni sus argumentos.

Cambios en el código existente:
- hotel_floor.gd gana `OBJECTIVES`: nombre -> ruta res:// del manejador. Son rutas y no preload porque habría un ciclo: televisions_objective.gd precarga tv_placement.gd, que precarga hotel_floor.gd.
- hotel_main.gd:
  - crea un manejador por nombre al construir el piso (`objectives`, `build_objectives()`);
  - se los pide por etapa en el orden de STAGES (`stage_objectives()`);
  - asienta con ellos el manifiesto (`settle_objectives()`) y los coloca en `populate_floor`;
  - `host_gate()` pasa a ser un recorrido de los manejadores;
  - da `goal_points()` al director.
- lifts.stage_progress() junta las `lines` de los manejadores.
- pacing_director.goal_rooms()/ambush() usan `level.goal_points()`.
- tv_placement.settle() recibe el `kind`. Por defecto es HOTEL_FLOOR, porque record_manifest_golden.gd y echo_test.gd la llaman sin él.

CONTRATO DE progress(stage) -> Dictionary {ready: bool, done: int, needed: int, kind: String, lines: Array, extra: Dictionary}
- Con kind "" el manejador no se aplica: la etapa no lo pide o no hay nada de él en el piso. No sujeta la puerta ni da nombre a la meta, pero sus `lines` siguen saliendo en la pausa.
  - El código pedido sin muebles devuelve kind "" y conserva la línea «NÚMEROS DEL CÓDIGO».
- host_gate:
  - met = AND de los `ready` de los que se aplican; si no se aplica ninguno, session.can_depart();
  - goal.kind/done/needed salen del último que se aplica, en el orden de STAGES[n].objectives;
  - las claves de `extra` se escriben en session.goal.

EQUIVALENCIA QUE HAY QUE CONSERVAR
- session.goal debe acabar con las mismas claves, los mismos valores y el mismo orden de primera inserción. Hoy el orden es kind, done, needed, ready (las trae la sesión) y luego sets_done, sets_needed, blackout.
- session.changed se emite las mismas veces y en el mismo orden.
- No hay llamadas de RNG nuevas ni cambia su orden.
- El tick() del manejador de televisores:
  - hace creature_channel_hop siempre;
  - si la etapa pide televisores y su ala tiene teles, escribe sets_done y sets_needed y después prueba el apagón. Es el bloque literal de host_gate, que así sigue antes de update_goal.
- El `extra` de televisores vuelve a escribir sets_done y sets_needed con el mismo valor sobre claves que ya existen, así que no cambia nada.
- tick() corre para todos los manejadores del piso, cada fotograma, donde hoy se llama creature_channel_hop. El de código no hace nada.

extends RefCounted
## One thing a stage can ask of the survivors (docs/OFICINAS.md 11.2): the
## floor's kind lists them by name (kind.OBJECTIVES) and each stage names the
## ones it asks (kind.STAGES[n].objectives). The level builds one of each with
## the floor and asks them rather than naming each: host_gate() whether the
## stage is met, the lifts the lines of the pause screen, the director where
## the team is going. The hotel's two wrap what they always were
## (televisions.gd and code_lock.gd), whose state, RPCs and saving stay theirs.

## The level that owns it (hotel_main.gd).
var level

## Before the floor is built, the same on every machine: what it fixes of the
## manifest, and what it hands the level to keep. Nothing, for one with
## nothing to choose.
static func settle(_manifest: Dictionary, _survivors: int, _kind: GDScript) -> Dictionary: return {}

func setup(owner_level) -> void: level = owner_level

## Put on the floor just built (hotel_main.populate_floor()).
func place() -> void: pass

## What a new stage takes back of it. Nothing yet: the hotel's keep their
## state for the whole floor, and the goal they write is the session's, which
## starts clean with each stage.
func reset() -> void: pass

## How it stands on that stage: {ready, done, needed, kind, lines, extra}. No
## kind: it does not apply there (not asked, or nothing of it on this floor),
## so it neither holds the stage's door nor names its goal; its lines are
## still the pause screen's. `extra`: keys it keeps in the session's goal.
func progress(_stage: int) -> Dictionary: return idle()

## Not applying, with whatever lines it still shows.
func idle(lines: Array = []) -> Dictionary:
	return {"ready": true, "done": 0, "needed": 0, "kind": "", "lines": lines, "extra": {}}

## Where what the stage still asks of it stands, for the director.
func goal_points(_stage: int) -> Array[Vector3]:
	var points: Array[Vector3] = []
	return points

## Once a frame on the machine in charge, whatever the stage.
func tick(_delta: float) -> void: pass

## What a floor kept to be continued holds of it (floor_save.gd still writes
## the same keys itself, in its own order), and putting it back.
func snapshot() -> Dictionary: return {}

func restore(_data: Dictionary) -> void: pass
```

B) Crear game/floors/objectives/televisions_objective.gd con EXACTAMENTE este contenido:
```
extends "res://game/floors/objectives/objective.gd"
## The sets of the stage's wing, lit (game/app/televisions.gd, `level.tvs`):
## enough of them on opens the stage's door, the last one but one takes the
## wing's power, and the creature travels between the lit ones. What
## host_gate(), the lifts and the director asked of the sets, asked here; the
## sets, their RPCs and their state stay in televisions.gd.
const TV_PLACEMENT := preload("res://game/world/generation/tv_placement.gd")
const NAME := "televisions"

## Which sets each stage asking for them is played on, and every other "tv"
## of the manifest built as its cabinet (tv_placement.settle()).
static func settle(manifest: Dictionary, survivors: int, kind: GDScript) -> Dictionary:
	return TV_PLACEMENT.settle(manifest, survivors, kind)

func place() -> void: level.tvs.place_televisions()

## A stage that asks for sets is played on its own wing's: each counts the
## ones standing in its wing and starts from nothing.
func progress(stage: int) -> Dictionary:
	if not level.kind.asks(stage, NAME): return idle()
	var sets: Array = level.tvs.stage_televisions(stage)
	if sets.is_empty(): return idle()
	var needed: int = TV_PLACEMENT.needed(level.session.roster_count)
	var done := 0
	for index in sets:
		if level.tvs.televisions[index].on: done += 1
	return {"ready": done >= needed, "done": done, "needed": needed, "kind": NAME, "lines": [["TELEVISORES", "%d / %d" % [done, needed]]], "extra": {"sets_done": done, "sets_needed": needed}}

## Its sets still dark.
func goal_points(stage: int) -> Array[Vector3]:
	var points: Array[Vector3] = []
	for index in level.tvs.stage_televisions(stage):
		var set = level.tvs.televisions[index]
		if is_instance_valid(set) and not set.on: points.append(set.global_position)
	return points

## The creature's hop between lit sets, on any stage, as it always was. And
## where the stage asks for sets, their count kept in the goal and the
## blackout it trips, written before host_gate() reads the goal and in the
## order they always were: the goal is saved and sent as it stands.
func tick(delta: float) -> void:
	level.tvs.creature_channel_hop(delta)
	var session = level.session
	if not level.kind.asks(session.stage, NAME) or level.tvs.stage_televisions().is_empty(): return
	var needed: int = TV_PLACEMENT.needed(session.roster_count)
	var done: int = level.tvs.televisions_on()
	session.goal["sets_done"] = done
	session.goal["sets_needed"] = needed
	# With one set left to light, this wing loses its power and the
	# creature hunts without tiring. It is the wing's power, not the
	# floor's: the next one is found lit.
	# Not again once the floor's key has given it its lights back.
	if level.rule("blackout") == 1 and done >= needed - 1 and not session.goal.get("blackout", false) and not session.goal.get("restored", false):
		session.goal["blackout"] = true
		level.ledger.note_dark()
		session.changed.emit()

## The sets on, by their place in the floor's list (floor_save.gd's "sets").
func snapshot() -> Dictionary:
	return {"sets": level.tvs.televisions.map(func(set): return is_instance_valid(set) and set.on)}

func restore(data: Dictionary) -> void:
	var sets: Array = data.get("sets", [])
	for index in mini(sets.size(), level.tvs.televisions.size()):
		if bool(sets[index]): level.tvs.apply_television(index, true, true)
```

C) Crear game/floors/objectives/code_objective.gd con EXACTAMENTE este contenido:
```
extends "res://game/floors/objectives/objective.gd"
## The four numbers of the last door, found in the furniture of the stage's
## wing and read into the keypad (game/app/code_lock.gd, `level.code`). On top
## of the sets where a stage asks for both: the door gives way with the code
## in and the sets lit. The drawers, the key, the hints, their RPCs and their
## state stay in code_lock.gd (the key is placed after the documents, by
## hotel_main.populate_floor()).
const DIGITS := preload("res://game/world/generation/digit_placement.gd")
const NAME := "code"

func place() -> void: level.code.place_containers()

func progress(stage: int) -> Dictionary:
	if not level.kind.asks(stage, NAME): return idle()
	var lines: Array = [["NÚMEROS DEL CÓDIGO", "%d / %d" % [level.code.found_digits.size(), DIGITS.COUNT]]]
	# A floor with no furniture has no numbers to find: the stage is the sets'
	# or the refuge's, though the pause screen still counts them.
	if level.code.containers.is_empty(): return idle(lines)
	return {"ready": bool(level.code.code_entered), "done": level.code.found_digits.size(), "needed": DIGITS.COUNT, "kind": NAME, "lines": lines, "extra": {}}

## The furniture with a number in it not gone through yet, and the keypad
## while the code is not in.
func goal_points(_stage: int) -> Array[Vector3]:
	var points: Array[Vector3] = []
	for piece in level.code.containers:
		if is_instance_valid(piece) and int(piece.digit) >= 0 and not piece.searched: points.append(piece.global_position)
	if is_instance_valid(level.code.lock) and not level.code.code_entered: points.append(level.code.lock.global_position)
	return points

## What floor_save.gd keeps of it: the furniture gone through and by whom, the
## panels left open, the hints read where they lie, and whether the code is in.
func snapshot() -> Dictionary:
	var searched: Array = []
	for index in level.code.containers.size():
		var piece = level.code.containers[index]
		if is_instance_valid(piece) and piece.searched: searched.append([index, int(level.code.found_by.get(piece.slot, level.player.slot))])
	return {"searched": searched, "panels": level.code.opened_panels(), "hints": level.code.hints_read.keys(), "code": level.code.code_entered}

func restore(data: Dictionary) -> void:
	level.catch_up_progress({"searched": data.get("searched", []), "code": data.get("code", false), "panels": data.get("panels", [])})
	for id in data.get("hints", []): level.code.note_read(int(id))
```

Son unas 37 líneas; empieza por el bucle de `untouchable` y contiene `creature_channel_hop(delta)`, el bloque de `sets` con el apagón y las tres ramas de `session.update_goal`.
- new_string, EXACTAMENTE:
```
## One handler for each objective the floor's kind can ask for, in the order
## it lists them; built before anything of the floor is settled.
func build_objectives() -> void:
	objectives.clear()
	for objective_name in kind.OBJECTIVES:
		var handler = load(kind.OBJECTIVES[objective_name]).new()
		handler.setup(self)
		objectives[objective_name] = handler

## What each objective fixes of the manifest before the hotel is built, by
## name (the sets it keeps: tv_sets).
func settle_objectives(survivors: int) -> Dictionary:
	var settled := {}
	for objective_name in objectives:
		var handler_script = load(kind.OBJECTIVES[objective_name])
		settled[objective_name] = handler_script.settle(manifest, survivors, kind)
	return settled

## The handlers a stage asks, in the order it lists them (kind.STAGES).
func stage_objectives(stage := -1) -> Array:
	var number: int = session.stage if stage < 0 else stage
	var result: Array = []
	if number < 1 or number > kind.count(): return result
	for objective_name in kind.stage(number).objectives:
		if objectives.has(objective_name): result.append(objectives[objective_name])
	return result

## Where what the stage in hand still asks stands, objective by objective in
## its order: the director's goals and ambushes.
func goal_points() -> Array[Vector3]:
	var points: Array[Vector3] = []
	for handler in stage_objectives(): points.append_array(handler.goal_points(session.stage))
	return points

func host_gate(delta: float) -> void:
	for seat in untouchable.keys():
		untouchable[seat] = float(untouchable[seat]) - delta
		if untouchable[seat] <= 0.0: untouchable.erase(seat)
	# Every objective of the floor, every frame, whatever the stage: the
	# creature's hop between lit sets runs on any of them, and what an
	# objective writes of its own into the goal is there before it is read.
	for objective_name in objectives: objectives[objective_name].tick(delta)
	# What the stage asks, in its order. One that does not apply neither holds
	# the door nor names the goal; the last that does names it (the code, on
	# top of the sets), and a stage with none that applies is met in its refuge.
	var met := true
	var naming := {}
	for handler in stage_objectives():
		var progress: Dictionary = handler.progress(session.stage)
		if String(progress.kind).is_empty(): continue
		met = met and bool(progress.ready)
		for key in progress.extra: session.goal[key] = progress.extra[key]
		naming = progress
	if naming.is_empty(): session.update_goal(delta, session.can_depart())
